reviews.shade: ROUND LAB For Men Pine Calming Cica Lotion 200mL
reviews.text: Light and calming. I love this moisturizer, especially in the summertime. I'm 43, and have sensitive, acne-prone skin. This stuff is the best: doesn't irritate or break me out, absorbs somewhat quickly (I spend extra time massaging it in), and none/very light scent.
reviews.zh: 輕盈又舒緩。我好鍾意呢隻保濕霜，尤其係夏天。我 43 歲，有敏感肌同暗瘡傾向。呢隻嘢係最勁嘅：唔會刺激我、唔會令我爆瘡、吸收得幾快（我會額外花時間按摩）、冇香味或者好淡嘅香味。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB For Men Pine Calming Cica Lotion 200mL
reviews.text: I'm exploring using lotions to replace a cream in the hotter months and I saw good reviews of this product. I didn't have any expectations but I am enjoying it. This lotion is light but leaves my skin hydrated with a whisper of moisture, also I feel that it forms a light layer over my skin that keeps it soft. It takes a little to absorb but by just padding a little bit more is enough. I see myself approaching to it in my morning routine rather than at the evening. Overall, I will continue to use it and see if my skin still likes it
reviews.zh: 我喺探索用乳液取代面霜用喺熱嘅月份，睇到呢個產品嘅好評。我本來冇乜期望，但用落幾鍾意。呢隻乳液輕盈，但會畀一絲水潤感幫我保濕，而且我感覺佢喺我皮膚表面形成一層薄薄嘅保護膜令皮膚保持柔軟。吸收需要少少時間，但只要多拍幾下就夠。我諗我會將佢加入朝早嘅護膚程序，而唔係夜晚。整體嚟講，我會繼續用，睇下我嘅皮膚係咪仲受落。

reviews.text: Extremely lightweight and soothing. I put it on as the last step of my summer skincare routine and it seals everything in, leaving my skin refreshed and glowy
